usesFeatures.description: Subset of core/features.json's keys this language's curriculum/realization actually reference — validate-pack-v2.mjs checks every curriculum focus/fixed key against this list.

case.description: Case values this language declines by, in the language's own vocabulary (empty for a caseless language, e.g. hypothetical en/zh).

answerPolicy.description: core/model's AnswerInput variants this language accepts today. Only 'typed' exists until AnswerInput.Spoken (UniversalCorePlan.md §5.4) is wired to a real provider.
